title: Tech Note: Building and Embedding Dashboards/Charts

historical_commentary.text: Dashboards and live metrics widgets remain a common and relevant UI pattern, but the specific 4DAF Dashboard/widget object model documented here no longer exists, since the entire 4D Ajax Framework has been discontinued in favor of modern web component approaches.
related_updates: 4D Ajax Framework (4DAF), including its Dashboard widget system, has been fully discontinued
Modern 4D dashboards are typically built with Qodly Studio (2021+) components, 4D View Pro (2018+) charting, or embedded third-party JS dashboard libraries
